title: 'Saikyou Degarashi Ouji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tanba 's Saikyou Degarashi Ouji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi: Munou wo Enjiru SS Rank Ouji wa Koui Keishousen wo Kage kara Shihai suru ( The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for the Throne ) light novel announced a pair of additional cast on Monday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'World Is Dancing' Unveils Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Third Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuto Mihara 's World Is Dancing manga unveiled additional cast, the ending theme, and a third promotional video on Monday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 2 at 10:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Azusa Banjo's I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl Manga Gets TV Anime
content: An official X (formerly Twitter ) account opened on Monday to announce the television anime adaptation of Azusa Banjo 's I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl ( Koisuru (Otome) no Tsukurikata ) manga, and also revealed a commemorative illustration from Banjo.
author: ANN

title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne Anime Reveals 2 New Cast Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Tanba and Yuunagi 's The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne ( Saikyō Degarashi Ōji no Anyaku Teii Arasoi: Munō o Enjiru SS-Rank Ōji wa Kōi Keishō-sen o Kage kara Shihai Suru ) light novel series revealed two more cast members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl Anime Adaptation Announced
content: Azusa Banjo’s romantic comedy manga, I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl , is getting an anime adaptation. Further details such as the studio, staff, voice cast, and release date are yet to be revealed.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Koisuru (Otome) no Tsukurikata' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: Publishing company Ichijinsha announced a television anime adaptation of Azusa Banjou 's Koisuru (Otome) no Tsukurikata ( I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl ) on Monday, revealing a commemorative illustration drawn by the original creator (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: The World Is Dancing Reveals Final Trailer, Ending Theme Song, Episode 1 Preview, New Characters & Cast
content: The upcoming historical anime The World Is Dancing released the official final trailer ahead of its June 29 premiere, previewing the ending theme song “Unnamed Flower” by hockrockb. Additional voice cast members, Episode 1 details, and streaming information were also revealed.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kageki Shojo!! Manga Continues Hiatus, Returns on August 28
content: The manga went on a one-issue break on April 28 due to Saiki's health, and was scheduled to return in the magazine's August issue that Hakusensha will release on June 26. Saiki revealed on her X (formerly Twitter ) account on April 6 that she was injured at a music festival she had attended in Ariake district in Tokyo…
author: ANN

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Franchise Announces 1st World Tour With Performance in Los Angeles
content: Cygames ' Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise revealed on Sunday the future stops for the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage global tour, which had its first event in Tokyo on June 20-21. The tour will have stops in Los Angeles, London, Seoul, and Yokohama.
author: ANN
